description: Update an existing link's properties. You can change the name, platform-specific URLs, fallback URLs, parameters, and metadata. Only the fields you provide will be modified.

allowQueryPassthrough.description: When true, query params appended to this link URL at click time (e.g. ?orderId=123) are merged into the resolved link's parameters and OVERRIDE stored parameters with the same key. Parameter values arrive as strings. Applies on both immediate app open and after deferred install. No SDK change required.

androidUrl.description: New URL to open on Android devices

fallbackUrl.description: New fallback URL for unsupported platforms

iosUrl.description: New URL to open on iOS devices

linkId.description: The unique identifier of the link to update

metadata.description: New arbitrary metadata attached to the link

name.description: New human-readable name for the link

parameters.description: New key-value parameters passed through the deep link

name: update_link
title: Update Link
